Slippage is an unavoidable delay in the transaction process due to the network congestion on the Ethereum blockchain. It is caused by the fact that transactions are broadcast in order to the miners, who then verify and validate them. In some cases, this process takes a long time, which can cause delays in the transaction being confirmed.
